item.text:
No additional independent defect was confirmed in this pass. The core synchronization review remains concentrated in the newly confirmed `sync_log` issues:

- delta synchronization can merge obsolete suffix data into a snapshot,
- `AcceptSync` can reduce the receiver’s decided index,
- both violate monotonic decided-state guarantees and remain reproducible.

The audit remains at 26 confirmed findings. Current high-impact evidence includes deterministic and randomized snapshot failures, durable persistent-write corruption, LFU and LRU cache-transfer failures, runtime retry duplication, and reconfiguration/compaction state bugs.

All affected code, necessary conditions, reproduction commands, and retained outputs are in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
